purpose: Future candidate design evidence; no implementation or attempt counted
finding: Single-slot auto pipeline improves b1 prefill offload latency by 0.349586 ms (95% CI 0.269728..0.429443) and gap by 0.373642 ms (0.274240..0.473045). Applying it to b8 also improves prefill but has a resolved b8 decode regression after prefix setup.
hypothesis: Bound automatic one-slot eligibility to pipeline calls with <=2048 input tokens. Keep the four-slot policy above that threshold, including the entire b8 primary workload. This removes the changed high-volume capacity regime while preserving the evidenced small-prefill schedule.
limits: The b8 decode mechanism is unproven. Do not infer causation from unchanged bulk code or assume unchanged primary workload measurements will pass.
